ledger.claim: The driver never entered the pickup geofence. All 25 driver fixes in EV-GPS-00854 sit at 200.1508679602189 m from the pickup pin - min, mean and max identical - and the arrival analysis records qualifying_fix_count of 0 against the 120 m arrival radius that POL-NS-02 fixes for a LARGE_VENUE pickup, which is the zone class EV-TRIP-00854 records for this Suntec City Tower 3 booking. With not one qualifying in-radius fix, no admissible arrival exists under POL-NS-02.

POL-NS-01 is conjunctive and the driver fails it twice. Limb (b) requires the gps_trace to place the driver inside the geofence at or before the arrival event; the track places him 200 m outside that radius throughout, so limb (b) fails. Limb (c) requires a continuous dwell of at least the free waiting period in force - 180 seconds, read from EV-TRIP-00854.platform_policy.free_wait_sec - and the clause measures that dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the arrival tap; there are zero in-geofence fixes, so the dwell is 0 seconds and limb (c) fails as well. Breaking any single limb is enough, and here two of the four are broken: the cancellation fee is not chargeable under POL-NS-01.

This is the POL-NS-03 case, and POL-NS-03 is decided from coordinates alone. The driver's own trace shows him stationary - distinct_speeds_kph of [0] - from 18:10:00 to 18:14:00, 240 seconds, comfortably the required dwell, at a point 200.15 m from the pickup pin: outside the 120 m arrival radius but far inside the clause's 400 m ceiling, measured from trip_record.pickup. On those facts the driver did not arrive at the pickup point, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and the cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full.

Any payment to the driver here is platform-funded and cannot be netted against the rider's refund. Independently of where the driver stopped, the waiting period was never served. ledger.claim: The rider's case rests on clean evidence, so the 200 m finding carries full weight. EV-GPS-00854 has 100 percent coverage, 25 fixes at the 10 second sample interval with no gaps, and a first fix at 18:10:00 matching the trip record's arrival event to the second - zero clock skew against POL-NS-08(a)'s 90 second threshold. The chat log is complete at 3 messages matching trip_record.chat_message_count 3 with consecutive msg_ids, and EV-FARE-00854's cancellation_fee line of 4.50 reconciles with the 4.50 net figure in platform_policy, satisfying POL-NS-08(d). There is no impairment under POL-NS-08(a) to (d) and so nothing to discount under POL-GEN-02(2).

The driver was on station at the Suntec City pickup for the whole waiting window and beyond: his trace runs from 18:10:00 to 18:14:00 across 25 fixes, the distance to the pickup pin is constant at 200.15 m (min = max = mean) and the only speed recorded is 0 kph, so he held position for a continuous 240 seconds - 60 seconds longer than the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip under trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec. He did not cut and run; he waited out the clock and then some.

The sum charged is the published figure, not a bookkeeping artefact: fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee is SGD 4.50 and it reconciles exactly with trip_record.platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of SGD 4.50, with the derived money block reporting a difference of 0.00 and payment_status CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00. There is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect for the rider to exploit.

The arrival marker is not false and the waiting clock was not reset. At the 18:10:00 arrival event the driver's fixes place him 200.15 m from the pin - inside the 300 m marker threshold of POL-NS-05 - and his recorded speed is 0 kph, far below the 15 kph motion trigger. Both independent triggers of POL-NS-05 therefore fail, the arrival marker stands, and no false-arrival entry belongs in the referrals list against this driver.

The rider cannot be exonerated under POL-NS-04: limb (b) fails outright on the chat log. The rider's only message is at 18:10:30 and the driver replied at 18:10:40, ten seconds later and well inside the 120-second window, after having messaged first at 18:10:10; there was no silence to hold against the driver. Limb (a) is also doubtful, since 'I am here too.' names no position, entrance, block, tower or bay and asks for nothing - it is an assertion of presence, not a locating or coordinating message.

I concede the fee cannot be carried under POL-NS-01 itself. The driver's own trace places every one of his 25 fixes roughly 200 m from the pickup pin and records 0 qualifying fixes inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius, so limb (b) of POL-NS-01 is not made out on this record and the cancellation fee is not chargeable as a baseline no-show.

That concession does not dispose of the case: these are precisely the facts POL-NS-03 was written for. The driver's stationary fixes lie outside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius but only 200.15 m from the pickup pin, well inside the 400 m ceiling, and he held that position for a continuous 240 seconds - more than the required dwell of 180 seconds. POL-NS-02 yields to POL-NS-03 on such facts by its own terms, and POL-NS-03 governs the outcome including the driver's compensation.

The fault on these facts is pin ambiguity, not driver failure, and POL-NS-03(ii) therefore pays the driver. Neither party specified a sub-location in the chat (the rider said only 'I am here too.'), and the trip record shows registered_pickup_points of 3, well above the threshold of 2. The driver is accordingly entitled to the platform-funded goodwill payment of 50 percent of the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee, that is SGD 2.25, charged to the platform and never recovered from the rider.

POL-NS-03(i) does not strip that goodwill. Limb (i) bites only where the rider stated the correct entrance, block or tower in the chat log and the driver failed to move to it; the rider's messages here are 'I am here too.' at 18:10:30 and nothing more, with no entrance, block, tower or bay ever named. The driver cannot be said to have ignored a sub-location the rider never gave.

There is no anti-farming reason to withhold the driver's payment. driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, and that figure divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 100 is 0.01, below the 0.08 rate. Both limbs of the POL-NS-07 check must trip and neither does, so compensation is not withheld and POL-NS-09(d) is not engaged on this driver.

No other escalation trigger exists and this case should be decided on the record rather than parked in human review. rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so POL-NS-09(c) cannot fire; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, so POL-NS-09(d) cannot fire on the rider side; and no POL-NS-08 impairment is present - the trace carries 25 fixes at a 10-second cadence with max_gap_sec of 10 and full coverage, and the trip record's arrival event at 18:10:00 coincides with the first GPS fix, so there is no clock skew under limb (a) and no trace gap under limb (b). All artifacts relied on are COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, so confidence is not capped below the 0.70 floor.

POL-NS-06's shortfall rule is not the operative clause on this record and cannot be used to strip the POL-NS-03 goodwill. That clause measures the effective IN-GEOFENCE dwell computed under POL-NS-02; this driver never entered the geofence at all, and POL-NS-02's own carve-out sends a driver who held position outside the radius but within 400 m to POL-NS-03, which decides the outcome including his compensation. A driver who waited the full period at the wrong face of a venue does not lose the pin-ambiguity payment because he was on the wrong side of the radius line.

I do not assert POL-NS-06(i) and I disclose the reason: EV-ADVIS-00854-01 is MISSING, carries weight_multiplier 0.0 and no payload, so no traffic advisory is on file, the accumulation limb is unavailable, and nothing may be asserted against that absent artifact. The driver's 240-second dwell was a single uninterrupted interval in any event, so he needs no accumulation and rests no part of his case on the missing advisory.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver: the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full, and the platform pays the driver a goodwill payment of SGD 2.25. Here is the reasoning.

Arrival and the baseline charge. The driver's own GPS trace (EV-GPS-00854) puts him 200.15 m from the Suntec City Tower 3 pickup pin for the whole window, 18:10:00 to 18:14:00 - 25 fixes, stationary (recorded speed 0 km/h), with min, mean and max distance all identical at 200.15 m. The arrival radius for a LARGE_VENUE pickup (EV-TRIP-00854 zone class) is 120 m, and the trace yields 0 qualifying in-radius fixes. POL-NS-02's geofence test therefore fails. POL-NS-01 is conjunctive: limb (b) fails because no in-geofence fix exists at or before the 18:10:00 arrival tap, and limb (c) fails because the dwell, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, is 0 seconds against the 180-second free waiting period in force (EV-TRIP-00854.platform_policy.free_wait_sec). The baseline no-show charge does not stand; both advocates agree on this, and I accept it.

Wrong-entrance outcome (POL-NS-03). The driver was nonetheless stationary for the required dwell - 240 seconds, which meets the 180-second period - at a point outside the 120 m radius but only 200.15 m from the pin, inside the 400 m ceiling. POL-NS-02 says in terms that it yields to POL-NS-03 on these facts, and POL-NS-01 sends the case there too. Under POL-NS-03 the driver did not arrive at the pickup point and the cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full: SGD 4.50, which matches the fare_breakdown line (EV-FARE-00854 total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00).

Driver's compensation (POL-NS-03(ii)). The chat log (EV-CHAT-00854) shows neither party named an entrance, block, tower or bay - the whole exchange is 'I am here.', 'I am here too.', 'I still cannot see you.' - so limb (i) does not apply, and EV-TRIP-00854 records registered_pickup_points of 3 (2 or more). The mislocation is therefore attributed to pin ambiguity rather than to either party, and the driver receives a platform-funded goodwill payment of 50 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee = SGD 2.25, charged to the platform and never recovered from the rider. Under POL-GEN-03 the rider's refund and the driver's goodwill are independent and are not netted; the ruling value names the filing party's outcome, which is FULL_REFUND.

Claims that do not change the result. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider - the driver replied at 18:10:40, ten seconds after the rider's 18:10:30 message, so limb (b) fails; the rider's point that limb (c) is satisfied (rider_track at 0 m) is accepted but not decisive. POL-NS-05 does not fire: the arrival tap was at 200 m and 0 km/h, inside its 300 m and below its 15 km/h triggers, so the marker is not false and no false-arrival referral arises. POL-NS-12 does not apply because the arrival marker is BUTTON, not GPS_AUTO. POL-NS-06 would also produce a full refund, but the compensation question on an out-of-radius within-400 m stop is governed by POL-NS-03 under POL-NS-02's express carve-out, so the goodwill is payable; the driver's reading of that interaction is correct. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip - 1 no-show termination in 30 days against 100 completed trips, rate 0.01, below both thresholds - so compensation is not withheld and none of the rider's money funds it.

Escalation and impairment. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires: the arrival tap and the trace are reconciled by POL-NS-03 rather than left in unresolvable conflict; the pair's disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0; rider no_show_disputes_30d is 0; and the deciding evidence is unimpaired under POL-NS-08 - no clock skew (the 18:10:00 arrival event matches the first fix), 25 fixes at a 10-second cadence with max_gap_sec 10, a complete 3-message chat, and a fare line that reconciles. All artifacts the ruling rests on carry weight 1.0, so nothing is discounted and confidence is above the 0.70 floor. The two claims about the missing traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-00854-01) were discarded by the mechanical check for non-disclosure of that artifact's impairment, and in any event no deciding fact rests on that absent artifact. The lifetime counter prior_no_show_flags was mentioned only to say it cannot be used; it was not relied on.

The monetary effect is SGD 4.50 + SGD 2.25 = SGD 6.75, below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold (POL-GEN-05), so this ruling executes automatically. It is a provisional ruling and either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
